name: 7-Eleven Paradise Road

sources.observed: Official location corroborated with Maps address.

January 2026 Nils Hunerfurst exterior and June 2023 MarkRobert Murphy Sr photo: continuous white fascia with orange/green/red bands, black canopy columns, fuel pumps, high storefront glazing. February 2025 Barbara Hellein public counter: speckled countertop, dark louvered cabinets, wire racks, white ceiling grid, high perimeter glass. Exact layout not established.
Overhead inspected: shop rectangular to northeast; connected irregular canopy wraps west/south, separate from McDonalds north and Nuleaf east. Mapped canopy footprint corroborated.

uncertainDimensions: Shop height5.35m, canopysoffit4.95m/roof6.0m, interiorceiling4.65m and pump/columnpositions photo-fitted rather than surveyed.
Counter placement and shelving inferred; February2025 photograph establishes fixture appearance but not complete floorplan.
Local threshold ramp joins .15m shop floor to approximately .30m existing city paving; grade fitted to actual collision, not a survey.
implemented: Separate mapped shop and open irregular fuel canopy with white fascia, orange/green/red belts, black columns/beams and soffit fixtures.
High storefront glazing, raised address and original brand lettering, roof service units and three pump islands with screens, hoses and bollards.
Accessible public counter room with louvered cabinetry, wire racks, cups, original generic stock and speckled countertop. Fixture arrangement inferred from limited public photograph.
Threshold ramp corrected a real blocked return walk; storefront pane/low rail no longer overlap doorway. Optimized GLBs and fixed shared light pool preserved.
remaining: Canopy roof is currently flat; reference shows shallow curved roof segments and seam grid that need a measured follow-up.
Glazing remains opaque and backed by walls; recessed transparent openings and realistic interior/exterior continuity remain.
Public interior is a limited counter/arrival pass, not a complete store plan. Full aisles, chillers, checkout placement and hidden service rooms require further reference evidence.
Merchandise, pump fittings, signage graphic proportions and ceiling grid remain simplified; no photorealistic completion claim.
Forecourt paving/curbs retained from city source; reconcile exact island grading and add reference-supported pylon, bins and other site detail in later scoped pass.

nextPass.priority: Roof, glazing and reference-supported shop/site refinements
